# Actual Frobenius at the ordinary centre of the source family

2026-10-15. Separate bounded paper unit for canonical owner
EM-DIRECT-18F24A and support EM-CM24CONN-63E74C9D. Root
EM-DVR-FBF223 supplied the centre candidate and is a mathematical
coauthor, not a decisive independent reviewer. This author proof is
for subsequent distinct review, not a Native acceptance.

The fixed input is
`control/ROOT_CM24_ORDINARY_CENTRE_TRUE_FROBENIUS_INITIAL_DATA_CANDIDATE_20261015.md`,
3233B, SHA256b923c06d9b3060c7f00cb1407c1090e18ed81cbc09de104982e0976942fc4925.
The previously frozen 13972B geometry proof and6074B manifest remain
unchanged. Their isogeny/connection identities are reused, not their
pending review status. No old diag(1,p) comparison establishes the
claim proved here. All arithmetic below is paper arithmetic, for
every original prime, with no selected numerical instance.

## Fixed centre, ring and basis

Let p≡13,19mod24. Thus p≥13 and p≡1mod3. Choose one root
nu∈Z_p of nu²=−3; existence follows from the Eisenstein argument
below and Hensel's lemma. It is fixed throughout. At t=0 the actual
source curve is

    E: y²=x³−15x+22 over Z_p,
    Q=(3,2), omega=dx/(2y), eta=x dx/(2y).

Its discriminant is6912, a p-unit. Reuse the normalized source
three-isogeny followed by its nu scaling at t=0, denoted j:E->E.
It has degree3, kernel {O,Q,−Q}, and invariant differential
pullback j^*omega=nu omega. All coefficients extend over Z_p;
the affine poles at the kernel are the regular projective map to O.

The exact geometric Gauss–Manin reduction at t=0 gives the class

    chi=(nabla_t omega)|_0=(eta−omega)/6.

The two classes e=(omega,chi) form a Z_p-basis of H¹_dR(E/Z_p):
the change from the Weierstrass basis (omega,eta) has determinant1/6.
In this EXACT scalar cohomology basis the earlier literal differential
identities give

    j^*e=e diag(nu,−nu).                             (1)

Here e is a row of basis classes; columns of a matrix are pullbacks
of those classes. The underlying rational exact terms are handled
by their de Rham/Čech representatives. Nothing here evaluates an
endpoint integral or drops a relative-boundary contribution.

## Integer norm representation and its independent sign rules

We prove the representation needed by the candidate rather than
assuming the full CM ring has integer, rather than half-integer,
coordinates. Let O=Z[varpi], varpi²+varpi+1=0, in Q(√−3).
Its norm is N(r+s varpi)=r²−rs+s². This ring is norm-Euclidean:
rounding the two real coordinates in the basis1,varpi gives an error
whose coefficients have absolute values≤1/2, hence norm≤3/4<1.
It is therefore a PID.

Since p≡1mod3, Fp has a primitive cube root, so reduction
varpi↦that root gives a prime ideal of index p in O. A generator
pi has norm p. Because O/(2)=F4, and reduction of the six units
surjects onto F4^*, multiply pi by a unit to obtain pi≡1mod2O.
Writing pi=r+s varpi now gives s even. With nu_0=2varpi+1,

    pi=(r−s/2)+(s/2)nu_0=a+b nu_0,
    a,b∈Z, p=a²+3b².                               (2)

No assertion that nu_0 equals the chosen p-adic root is needed to
prove this integer identity. Mod3, a²=1; change pi to −pi if
necessary to fix a≡1mod3. Both a and b are nonzero and have
absolute values<p: b=0 would make the prime p a square, and a=0
would make p divisible by3. For completeness the normalization fixes
the magnitude/sign of a and |b|: the two norm-p prime ideals are
conjugate, and units preserving the integral suborder Z[nu_0]
for these odd-norm generators after the mod2 normalization reduce
to±1. Thus only conjugation, the sign of b, remains after fixing a.

Equivalently splitting gives a simple root of X²+3 in Fp, which
lifts uniquely after its residue is chosen since2nu is a unit.
For this fixed nu, choose the sign of b so that

    lambda=a+b nu∈p Z_p, mu=a−b nu∈Z_p^*,
    lambda*mu=p.                                    (3)

Exactly one sign works: their product is0modp but their sum2a is
nonzero modp. In particular v_p(lambda)=1 and v_p(mu)=0.
These are arithmetic/embedding rules independent of any target or
Frobenius trace value; no endpoint quantity selected the signs.

## The endomorphism identities survive good reduction

First prove j²=[−3] in characteristic zero. Their invariant
differentials agree, because nu²=−3. The difference as elliptic
endomorphisms has zero differential. Every nonzero endomorphism in
characteristic zero is a separable isogeny, hence has nonzero
differential; the difference must therefore be zero. The resulting
endomorphism identity extends over the good integral model and
specializes to every residue characteristic p>3. It is not being
inferred solely from a zero differential AFTER reduction.

The polarized dual satisfies hat(j) o j=[3]. Since (−j) o j=[3]
as well, surjectivity of j gives

    hat(j)=−j.

For the actual integral endomorphism

    F=[a]+[b]j:E/Z_p -> E/Z_p,
    hat(F)=[a]−[b]j,
    hat(F) o F=[a²+3b²]=[p].                        (4)

Duality here is additive on endomorphisms, and the symmetric
principal polarization is the one on this elliptic curve. Equation(4)
holds on both fibers. F and its dual cannot reduce to the zero map,
because multiplication by p is a nonconstant degree-p² morphism
even in characteristic p. Dual isogenies have the same degree;
taking degrees in(4) therefore gives deg(F)=p also on the special
fiber. This explicitly rules out a hidden degree drop on reduction.

By(1) or directly on invariant differentials, F^*omega=lambda omega.
Its reduction has zero differential by(3). A degree-p nonconstant
curve morphism with zero differential is purely inseparable of degree p.
It factors as a relative p-Frobenius followed by a degree-one
isomorphism. Since E is defined over Fp, identify its Frobenius twist
with that same displayed model and write

    F modp = epsilon o Fr_p,
    epsilon∈Aut_(Fpbar)(E,O).                       (5)

This argument identifies the inseparable degree, not merely a
determinant/trace resemblance of two arbitrary matrices.

## The rational three-torsion point fixes the actual Frobenius sign

For this model j(E)=54000. The only relevant exceptional
automorphism values would be0 or1728, and

    54000=2⁴*3³*5³,
    54000−1728=52272=2⁴*3³*11².

No original prime divides either number. In characteristic>3 the
origin-preserving geometric automorphism group is therefore{+1,−1}.
Thus epsilon in(5) has only those two possibilities, uniformly in
the original prime family.

The point Q reduces to a rational point of exact order3 and lies
in the kernel of j. Consequently

    F(Q)=[a]Q=Q, Fr_p(Q)=Q,

because a≡1mod3. Negative Frobenius would instead send Q to−Q,
which differs from Q as3 is prime to p and Q has exact order3.
Therefore epsilon=+1, and

    F modp = Fr_p as actual elliptic endomorphisms.  (6)

This is a concrete Frobenius lift over Z_p. It is neither a lift
postulated from slopes nor the old free ordinary-point normalization.
The use of the rational Q also explains why the sign a≡1mod3
selects the correct Frobenius rather than its negative.

## Functorial crystalline initial matrix and variance

Use contravariant H¹_cris(E_Fp/Z_p). The smooth proper lift E/Z_p
has the standard functorial crystalline–de Rham comparison with
H¹_dR(E/Z_p). Because F is an actual morphism lift of(6), its
de Rham pullback corresponds to crystalline Frobenius. This uses
the usual functorial comparison theorem, not a theorem deduced from
the spectrum of a matrix. The Witt Frobenius of W(Fp)=Z_p is the
identity, so at this centre the Frobenius is Z_p-linear.

On H¹, pullback is additive for sums of elliptic endomorphisms
(via the addition map and its two primitive degree-one factors).
In the fixed integral row basis e=(omega,chi) of(1), we obtain

    F_cris^* e=e M_0,
    M_0=diag(a+b nu,a−b nu),
    tr(M_0)=2a, det(M_0)=p,
    v_p(M_0,11)=1, v_p(M_0,22)=0.                   (7)

The valuation notation in the last line concerns the two displayed
diagonal eigenvalues. Thus this centre is ordinary, a consequence of
the actual Frobenius computation, not an assumption used to identify
its sign. This exact basis and matrix are p-integral but M_0 is
not a Z_p-module automorphism.

The convention matters even though M_0 is diagonal. Equation(7)
is a COHOMOLOGY PULLBACK matrix, with columns equal to images of
the basis elements. For a scalar functional composed with this
pullback, its coordinate column transforms by M_0^T. For the dual
Frobenius STRUCTURE on the dual isocrystal, defined so that the
evaluation pairing is Frobenius-invariant, the matrix is instead
(M_0^(−1))^T over Q_p. A period-solution convention must specify
which of these operations it represents. Neither can be silently
identified with an old chosen diag(1,p) initial matrix of an L_n
transport; that matrix lacked this genuine geometric initial datum
and even used the spectrally displaced operator.

## Completed centre scope; the endpoint problem is separate

The delivered lemma is precisely(6)–(7), with independent arithmetic
representation/sign selection, good-reduction degree proof, rational
three-torsion sign test and an explicit integral scalar cohomology
basis. Standard Eisenstein/elliptic/cohomological facts are not
claimed globally new; the contribution is their exact binding to
this source model and its centre Frobenius normalization.

Transport of this geometric Frobenius to zeta is not constructed.
It must respect the actual geometric connection, integrality/domain,
nonsplit coefficient automorphism and the distinction from raw
coordinate-power endpoint drift. Nor do these centre data give a
complete unit-point hypergeometric value or the divided complementary
Legendre endpoint/first jet. No map to the full original relative
functional ell(T)=3Y with H_b and quarter terms is provided. Those
questions, Y/Z/kappa and all original parents remain OPEN.

Only bounded paper deduction and local custody reads/writes/hashes.
No scientific code, prime/sample, checker/Hart/solve, new search,
Source/RA/Native/STATE/VIEW action, owner/claim/Task/branch or
successor. P000/Heartbeat X6 external-arithmetic typing is unchanged.
The earlier frozen geometry originals are not modified.

# Ordinary-centre Frobenius: bounded nonauthor review

2026-10-15 UTC. Reviewer EM-N-DEA587, retaining own prior contribution
identity EM-DVR-F27A61. This is a local directed NONBLIND mathematical
review, not a Native Driver review, a new CM research assignment or an
execution under the existing RR133 run/lease.

**Verdict: BOUNDED PASS; no mandatory mathematical correction.** The
fixed proof establishes the actual p-Frobenius lift and its integral
cohomology matrix at t=0 for the stated primes. The conclusion does not
extend to transport to zeta, endpoint periods, the relative functional,
or completion of any parent objective.

## Fixed targets and disclosure

The reviewed author proof is
`CM24_ORDINARY_CENTRE_ACTUAL_FROBENIUS_AND_CRYSTALLINE_INITIAL_MATRIX_20261015.md`,
10360 B, SHA256 `75004c35bd74fead4ef28e0c1bb6fafa7cefbb29ffd5c539f85478ab3a71f71e`,

and blob `0df39570469435b922a89ad7d2082779c6929994`.
The associated Root candidate is 3233 B, SHA256
`b923c06d9b3060c7f00cb1407c1090e18ed81cbc09de104982e0976942fc4925`,
blob `05362d6d7dc3bebf57234271ac92b88b638b397a`.
These three exact objects total 18244 B and remain unchanged.

Canonical mathematical owner EM-DIRECT-18F24A is retained. Support
EM-CM24CONN-63E74C9D and Root EM-DVR-FBF223 are actual mathematical
coauthors; neither supplies this nonauthor verdict. Before the author
freeze I read the Root candidate and the specified geometry passages,
and identified the need to justify the integer suborder, kernel, exact
basis, specialization and variance. I did not supply the centre
construction, its sign method or the author's completed proofs. This
prior directed exposure and review feedback are disclosed; the review
is not blind, platform-attested independence or preregistered discovery.

One existing temporary reader, `crt_bound_adversarial_read`, performed
a narrow reviewer-side sanity check of the fixed 10360 B proof's
integer representation and crystalline/dual conventions. It found no
substantive issue in that scope, treating the stated geometry identities
as inputs. It did not create another formal review, owner or claim,
write files, use network/Native tools or execute scientific code. I
checked the complete centre argument and give the verdict here.

## 1. The integral norm representation and both sign choices

For p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24, p is greater than 3 and splits
in the Eisenstein integers O. The proof supplies the needed elementary
argument: rounding both real coordinates in the basis (1,varpi) leaves
a norm at most 3/4, so O is norm-Euclidean and hence a PID. Sending
varpi to a primitive cube root in F_p gives an ideal of index p;
a generator has positive norm p.

The step from O to Z[sqrt(-3)] is present and valid. A norm-p generator
is nonzero modulo 2. Since O/(2) is F_4 and the six units map onto its
three nonzero elements, multiplication by a unit makes pi congruent
to 1 modulo 2O. In pi=r+s varpi this gives r odd and s even. Thus
a=r-s/2 and b=s/2 are ordinary integers and p=a^2+3b^2. No half-integral
coordinate is silently treated as integral.

Multiplying by -1 preserves the mod-2 normalization and fixes
a congruent to 1 modulo 3, since a^2 is 1 modulo 3. The two norm-p
ideals are conjugate; for these normalized generators the only units
remaining modulo 2 are +/-1. The stated uniqueness up to conjugation
and the remaining sign of b follows. Neither a nor b is zero, and
their size bounds imply a is nonzero modulo p.

After the p-adic root nu is fixed, the product
(a+b nu)(a-b nu)=p and the nonzero sum 2a modulo p show that exactly
one sign of b gives a+b nu divisible by p. The other factor is a
unit; therefore the valuations are exactly 1 and 0, not merely lower
bounds. This normalization uses arithmetic and the embedding, rather
than fitting a Frobenius trace or the desired endpoint value.

## 2. The actual kernel and scalar cohomology basis

I reused the fixed 13972 B geometry paper at its explicit degree/kernel
proof, equations (7)-(9), and the centre specialization of (14)-(16).
Its byte pins and the associated 6074 B manifest match the current
manifest. This is reuse of specified mathematical identities, not an
assumption that another review or Native acceptance has already passed.
No claim is made here to re-review that whole geometry package or its
literature/endpoint sections.

The displayed quotient map has kernel O,Q,-Q, not merely an arbitrary
rational point of order three. Thus the j used here really kills Q.
At t=0 the connection coefficients are alpha=-1/6 and beta_c=1/6,
so chi=(eta-omega)/6. The previous differential identities give

    j^*omega=nu omega,
    j^*eta=2nu omega-nu eta,
    j^*chi=-nu chi.

Consequently the diagonal matrix is in the specified actual basis,
not just a list of eigenvalues with an unspecified basis. The change
from (omega,eta) has determinant 1/6, a p-adic unit for all primes
in scope. The standard integral Weierstrass de Rham basis therefore
gives the claimed integral rank-two basis. The inherited rational
exact terms are cohomological/Čech terms; this statement does not
silently erase boundary values in a relative endpoint integral.

## 3. Specialization preserves the degree-p isogeny

The equality j^2=[-3] is proved before reduction. In characteristic
zero the difference has zero invariant differential, and a nonzero
elliptic endomorphism is a separable isogeny with nonzero differential.
Hence the difference vanishes. The integral maps agree on the generic
fiber and thus on the good model; the identity can then be specialized.
This correctly avoids the invalid converse from zero differential in
characteristic p.

The canonical polarized dual satisfies hat(j)=-j: both compose with
j to [3], and j is surjective. Additivity of the polarized dual gives
hat(F)=[a]-[b]j for F=[a]+[b]j, and hat(F)F=[p] on both fibers.
Neither special-fiber factor can be the zero map, since [p] remains
a nonconstant degree-p^2 morphism. Both are consequently isogenies.
Duality is compatible with base change and dual isogenies have equal
degree; taking degrees proves degree(F_bar)=p. There is no assumed
degree constancy hiding a possible zero reduction.

The invariant differential of F is multiplied by lambda=a+b nu,
whose reduction is zero. A nonconstant degree-p map between the
smooth curves therefore has inseparable degree p. Factoring through
relative p-Frobenius leaves a degree-one origin-preserving isomorphism.
The model is defined over F_p, so its Frobenius twist is the same
displayed curve. This supplies the asserted geometric automorphism
epsilon, rather than inferring Frobenius from trace and determinant.

## 4. The three-torsion point removes the sign ambiguity

The exceptional automorphism checks have the correct exact factorizations:
54000=2^4*3^3*5^3 and 54000-1728=2^4*3^3*11^2. None of the original
primes is 2,3,5 or 11. Thus the geometric origin-preserving automorphism
group in characteristic greater than three is exactly {+1,-1}.

The reduction of Q=(3,2) is a nonzero rational point of exact order
three, and j(Q)=O. Consequently F_bar(Q)=[a]Q=Q, while Fr_p(Q)=Q.
The alternative -Fr_p would send Q to -Q, which is different from Q.
This proves F_bar=Fr_p as an actual elliptic endomorphism. It also
explains why the chosen sign of a gives the actual Frobenius rather
